text:
ObservabilityBot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Route53 healthcheck flapping detected for us-east-2c. Failure rate 62% over last 5m. Probe group: azc-route53-probes. Triggered at 2026-03-15T03:12:36Z.
Alex M: oncall here, looking. what regions/flags are tripping?
Priya S: I see the alert, tagging @NetworkOps. do we have any ongoing maintenance in us-east-2c?
NetworkOps: no scheduled maintenance. we started seeing increased DNS timeouts from internal probes ~03:05 UTC. looks like a subset of probes only in that AZ.
ObservabilityBot: Recent metric sample (last 10m):
- probe_success_rate(us-east-2c): 0.38
- avg_latency: 420ms
- telemetry_uploads: missing for 03:08-03:14 UTC for several agents
Alex M: missing telemetry from agents is worrying — could be agent crash or network partition. can someone run the internal probe status endpoint?
Priya S: running quick check now.
Priya S: output from monitoring API:
```
GET /api/healthchecks/azc-route53
{
  "status": "degraded",
  "last_samples": ["timeout","timeout","no-response","timeout"]
}
```
Nadia R: EngOncallBot created incident INC-2026-042 (investigating Route53 probe flapping in us-east-2c) :eyes: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2026-042
EngOncallBot: PagerDuty notified: primary on-call Alex M, escalation to Priya S if no ack in 5m.
Alex M: acked. first triage: check Route53 healthcheck config + whether the probe fleet is overloaded. Priya, can you get agent host logs for any OOM/crash?
Priya S: grabbing logs. quick grep shows repeated `connection reset by peer` from agent -> route53 endpoints starting ~03:03. no oom entries.
NetworkOps: telemetry shows control-plane route to route53 endpoints from us-east-2c is having increased RSTs. looks like ephemeral networking errors.
Alex M: OK. two mitigation paths: (1) silence the noisy alert + restart probe agents in region, (2) temporarily failover Route53 checks to another probe group or reduce sensitivity so customer-facing routing doesn't flip.
CustomerSuccess: we have a small set of dedicated customers in us-east-2 experiencing increased 502s from inference endpoints since ~03:10. not widespread but noticed by support.
Priya S: got a live tail of agent logs, rolling restart command below. planning to restart probe-agent systemd unit on a few hosts to confirm recovery before broad restart:
```
# restart on a sample host
ssh jump@us-east-2c-probe-03 sudo systemctl restart probe-agent
journalctl -u probe-agent -f | sed -n '1,200p'
```
Alex M: go ahead with sample restart. I'll silence the alert for 30m while we investigate to avoid paging spam.
Alex M: `observability silence --check azc-route53-probes --for 30m --reason "investigating flapping probes (us-east-2c)"` :white_check_mark:
EngOncallBot: Silence applied by Alex M for 30m.
NetworkOps: sample restart shows agents re-establishing connections, success rate for probe-03 went from 20% -> 95% in 1 minute. looks promising.
Priya S: rolling restart across the remaining 6 probe hosts in us-east-2c now. monitoring the metrics.
ObservabilityBot: metric update (03:28 UTC): probe_success_rate(us-east-2c) increased to 84% after restarts. telemetry gap for 03:08-03:14 still logged but current uploads resumed.
CustomerSuccess: after the restarts, error rates for the impacted customers returned to baseline. they're still waiting on official incident note.
Alex M: good. still need to root cause why agents stopped uploading telemetry — likely network blip causing RSTs. please capture tcpdump on one host for the root cause runbook.
NetworkOps: capturing pcap now, saving to s3://internal/pcaps/azc/INC-2026-042.pcap.gz. looks like a sudden burst of SYN+RST from a transit switch before our agents recovered.
Priya S: documenting next steps in the incident ticket: 1) collect pcaps + agent logs, 2) escalate to infra network team for switch health, 3) consider probe fleet diversification if single-switch is single-point.
Nadia R: handing off to next on-call (Priya S is taking lead) at shift change 04:00 UTC. if you need followups, add them to INC-2026-042. I'm leaving a short summary in the ticket. :thumbsup:
EngOncallBot: Handoff recorded: from Alex M -> Priya S at 03:45 UTC.
Alex M: final note before handoff: alerts silenced until 03:42 UTC originally; re-enable auto-silence after we confirm stable for 30m. leaving incident open, monitoring.
Priya S: taking over. I'll coordinate with NetworkOps on the switch hardware and follow up with CustomerSuccess on the customer communication.
CustomerSuccess: please notify impacted customers with a short blurb: "We observed transient DNS/probe errors in us-east-2c impacting healthchecks which led to brief error spikes. Remediation actions were taken and rates have returned to baseline. We're investigating root cause and will follow up."
Alex M: 👍 thanks all. I'll update the incident summary with timelines.
ObservabilityBot: Note: silence will expire at 2026-03-15T03:42:36Z unless extended.
Nadia R: (after handoff) adding runbook links for Priya: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/route53-probes and internal network ticket NT-7892.
Priya S: acknowledged, leaving this thread open and will post updates in the incident ticket. last update will include RCA once infra analysis complete. :eyes:
